resources.string: Yamby HW+ defaults on any chipset; non-copy hardware decoding for other mpv apps is limited to RK3588. Explicit software decoding is retained.
Select the mpv players to patch in LSPosed, then restart those apps.\nIn Yamby, choose HW+, HW or SW in its own default decoder setting. You can still switch during playback.\n%1$s
LSPosed has not enabled shared preferences yet. Enable the module and reopen this page.
Add HW+ to Yamby default decoding (any chipset)
Other mpv players: prefer HW+ hardware decoding (RK3588 only; keep explicit SW)
Yamby HW+ automatic gray/white edge crop fix (RK3588 only)

Yamby setting support is not chipset-restricted; currently adapted for 2.1.0.11. Actual HW+ decoding support depends on the device.
You choose the scope. Only the tested Yamby app is recommended by default. Other mpv apps use detection of common JNI interfaces on RK3588 only.
When no matching interface is found, only diagnostics are logged. Pure native calls or fully obfuscated wrappers may need additional adaptation.
The edge fix defaults to off and uses each video's reported crop and texture dimensions. It skips unmatched inputs. Restart the player after changing settings.
gpu-next remains controlled by the original player. HDR colors, subtitles and seeking still require playback testing. Log tag: RKPlaybackFix.

Yamby Main10 HW ten-bit copy-back repair (off by default). Requires the paired Decode Stack buffer fix and matching ARM64 libraries. Preserves HW and full P010 precision. Selected Main10/HLG picture and pause/seek checks passed; not every green-screen cause is covered. Restart the player to apply or restore the original loader.

Yamby Exo recursive SeekHead seek repair (off by default). Reads real Cues for the pinned APK, fixing the recorded seek-to-start case. Disable and restart to restore the original extractor. Separate from system refresh rates and HDMI blackouts.
